content.heading: Enforcement
content.text: Where the time for making an application to set aside the arbitral award under section 34 has expired, then, subject to this section, the award shall be enforced in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in the same manner as if it were a decree of the court. Filing of an application under section 34 shall not by itself render the award unenforceable unless the Court grants an order of stay in accordance with the provisions of sub-section (3).
